biological_context.description: Plain-language summary of the experimental sample or the sample context for a prediction.

biosample_term.description: Ontology term for the experimental sample, or the sample the prediction is valid for

treatments_term_ids.description: Ontology term identifiers for the treatments applied to the samples for the purpose of perturbation.

method.description: Name of the experimental class or prediction model that produced this result.

label.description: Non-method specific human readable label for the node or edge

class.title: Class
class.description: The class of data this record belongs to.

enum_descriptions.prediction: An output of a computational model.
enum_descriptions.biological relationship: A curated relationship between biological entities.

crispr_modality.title: CRISPR Modality
crispr_modality.description: The purpose or intended effect of the CRISPR modification applied to the samples.

enum_descriptions.interference: Represses target gene expression using a CRISPR-directed regulatory effector.
enum_descriptions.activation: Increases target gene expression using a CRISPR-directed regulatory effector.
enum_descriptions.base editing: Introduces targeted nucleotide substitutions using a base editor.
enum_descriptions.prime editing: Introduces targeted substitutions, insertions, or deletions using a prime editor and a template-bearing guide RNA.
enum_descriptions.knockout: Disrupts a target gene to eliminate its function.
enum_descriptions.null: No CRISPR modality is recorded or applicable.
